Man Shoots, Arrests After Chainsaw Attack on Andhra Schoolgirls

In Andhra Pradesh, a man accused of attacking two Class 10 schoolgirls with a chainsaw was shot and arrested by police. One girl sustained serious injuries, while another was hurt attempting to intervene. The incident occurred inside a school. The accused was reportedly shot while allegedly trying to escape and carrying a knife. Chief Minister Naidu condemned the attack and directed harsh punishment for the accused.
